title: Approval of Quitclaim of 18 LADWP Distribution Easements - LADWP
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the Chief Administrative Officer
  Approval of Quitclaim of 18 LADWP Distribution Easements - LADWP
  Real Estate File No. J-15496-179. There is no cost incurred by LADWP to
  process this request.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3).

  City Council approval by ordinance is required.

3. Recommended by Office of the Chief Administrative Officer
  Approval of Right-of-Entry with 15321 – 15327 West Sunset LLC for
  Laydown and Staging for Pacific Palisades Recovery
  15323 West Sunset Boulevard, Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles County,
  California 90272 - LADWP File No. P-104852. The proposed Agreement is
  for an additional three-year term with monthly rental fees of $9,716 for the
  first year, $10,008 for the second year, and $10,308 for the third year, for a
  total of $360,384.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections 15269 and 15303.

4. Recommended by Office of the Chief Customer Officer,
  Communications, and Community Affairs
  Approval of Agreement No. 47933-6 for Credit Risk Services with Experian.
  The Agreement is for a three-year term, with two one-year renewal options,
  and a total amount not to exceed $10,000,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections 15060(c)(3) and 15378(b)(4).

5. Recommended by Office of the Chief Customer Officer,
  Communications, and Community Affairs
  Approval of Agreement 47990 for Services, Customer Relationship
  Management Replacement – Carahsoft Technology Corporation.
  The Agreement is for a term of five years and an amount not to exceed
  $30,068,716 including a 20 percent project contingency.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections 15060(c)(3) and 15378(b)(4).

6. Recommended by Office of the Chief Customer Officer,
  Communications, and Community Affairs
  Approval of Single Source Agreement No. 47996 for Comprehensive
  Affordable Multifamily Retrofits Program – Association for Energy
  Affordability, Inc. The Agreement is for a term of five years and an amount
  not to exceed $10,000,000.
  Determined item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections15060 (c)(3) and 15378 (b)(4).

7. Recommended by Office of the Chief Safety Officer
  Approval of Agreement No. 47057 for Mobile Medical Surveillance Services
  with Industrial Hearing & Pulmonary Management, Inc., dba Western Health.
  The Agreement is for an amount not to exceed $5,000,000 with a term of
  three years and two one-year extension options, for a maximum term of and
  five years from the date of execution.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

 8. Recommended by Office of the Chief Financial Officer
  Approval of Resolution Authorizing Payment of Premium for the Corporate
  Property Insurance Program for the policy period of January 1, 2027 through
  January 1, 2028. The proposed Resolution requests authority to procure
  coverage at a cost not to exceed $22 Million including taxes and fees.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

 9. Recommended by Office of the Chief Financial Officer
  Approval of Resolution for Energy Cost Adjustment Expenditures for the
  12-Month Period Commencing January 1, 2027. The proposed Resolution
  approves expenditures for inclusion in the Energy Cost Adjustment for the
  12-month period commencing January 1, 2027, and the median residential
  customer’s electric bill for the quarter will be lower by an average of 0.57
  percent, or $0.22 per month of $0.00073 per kWh.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

10. Recommended by Office of the Chief Financial Officer
  Approval of Authorization to Issue up to $1.11 Billion of Power System
  Revenue Bonds Under Resolution Nos. 5099 and 5100. The proposed
  Resolutions will authorize the issuance of up to $1.11 Billion of fixed-rate,
  tax-exempt Power System Revenue Bonds, 2026 Series D.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

11. Recommended by Office of the Chief Information Officer and
  Chief AI Officer
  Approval of Agreement Nos. 47028A, 47028B, 47028C, 47028D, 47028E,
  47028F, and 47028G for Cybersecurity Consulting Services – 22nd Century
  Technologies, Inc., Parsons Transportation Group, Guidehouse Inc.,
  Accenture LLP, Global Solutions Group, Inc., Cogent Infotech Corporation,
  Computer Aid Inc. The Agreements are for a term of five years and a
  cumulative amount not to exceed $80,000,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

12. Recommended by Office of the City Attorney
  Approval of First Amendment to Agreement No. 47976 between the
  City of Los Angeles, acting by and through the Los Angeles Department of
  Water and Power and Meyers Nave. The First Amendment adds $250,000
  for an aggregate budget of $500,000. The term of the Agreement,
  commencing on May 1, 2026, and terminating April 30, 2029, and the scope
  of legal services shall remain unchanged.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3).

13. Recommended by Office of the City Attorney
  Approval of Second Amendment to Agreement No. 47777 between the
  City of Los Angeles, acting by and through the Los Angeles Department of
  Water and Power and Theodora Oringher, P.C. The Amendment adds
  $500,000 for an aggregate budget of $1,000,000. The term of the
  Agreement, commencing on May 1, 2023, and terminating April 30, 2028,
  and the scope of legal services shall remain unchanged.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3).

14. Recommended by Office of the City Attorney
  Approval of Second Amendment to Agreement No. 47891 between the
  City of Los Angeles, acting by and through the Los Angeles Department of
  Water and Power and Stoel Rives, LLP. The Amendment adds $1,200,000
  for an amount not to exceed $5,000,000. The term of the Agreement,
  commencing on April 1, 2025, and terminating March 31, 2030, shall remain
  unchanged.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3).

15. Recommended by Office of the City Attorney
  Approval of Third Amendment to Legal Services Agreement between the
  City of Los Angeles, acting by and through LADWP and Munger, Tolles &
  Olson, LLP. The Amendment adds $10,000,000 for an aggregate budget of
  $40,000,000 and extends the term of the Agreement by one year, making the
  new termination date January 11, 2029.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3).

16. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of 2026-2031 LADWP Project Labor Agreement with the
  International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, Local 47. The proposed
  Project Labor Agreement is for the years 2026-2031 and requires no
  additional funding.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

17. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Authorization of Southern California Public Power Authority’s
  Engineering, Procurement, and Construction Agreement with DWT Inc. for
  the Linden Wind Repower Project. The Agreement has an estimated cost
  between $25 Million and $35 Million to be initially funded by the Power
  Revenue Fund.
  Determine item is statutorily exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15277.

18. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Contract No. 725 for Douglas Fir Poles, Through-Bored,
  Pressure Treated with Preservatives with Stella-Jones Corporation.
  The proposed Contract is for a term of one year with two one-year renewal
  options, for an estimated expenditure of $28,623,873 and an amount not to
  exceed $35,779,842.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

19. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Contract No. 815 for Construction Services of Underground
  Conduits and Substructures with Northwest Excavating, Inc. The Contract
  is for a term of one year with four one-year optional renewal periods, for an
  estimated expenditure of $364,208,818 and an amount not to exceed
  $455,261,02.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

20. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Agreement No. 47062 for Progressive Design-Build Services for
  Haynes Unit 8 Recycled Water-Cooling System Retrofit with Kiewit
  Infrastructure West Company. The Agreement is for a term of five years and
  an amount not to exceed $285,000,000 which includes an Owner’s
  contingency of $55,000,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

21. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Designation of Authorized Representatives for the Intermountain
  Power Project. This action does not have budget implications and does not
  require any additional funding.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

22. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Contract No. 54483 for an Amended and Restated Large
  Generator Interconnection Agreement with Babbitt Ranch Energy Center,
  LLC; Arizona Public Service Company; LADWP of the City of Los Angeles;
  Nevada Power Company; Salt River Project Agricultural Improvement and
  Power District; Tucson Electric Power Company; and the United States of
  America Navajo Participants for the Q196 Generator Interconnection Project
  and Surplus Generator Request SP107. LADWP has no ownership share in
  the Moenkopi-Cedar Mountain 500kV Line and does not anticipate any
  financial impact from the execution of the Amended and Restated Navajo
  Large Generator Interconnection Agreement.
  Determine item is statutorily exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15277.

  23. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Amendment No. 4 to Master Terms and Conditions Agreement
  No. FO-640-07/2010 and Service Order No. 00115662 with Telx Entities for
  Lease of Colocation Space at 600 West 7th Street, Los Angeles,
  California. The proposed Amendment is for a 12-month term with four
  one-year renewal options, a monthly recurring cost of $5,429.20 and a total
  not to exceed amount of $206,937.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

  24. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Single Source Contract No. 694 for Watthour Smart Meters for
  Power System with WESCO Distribution, Inc. The Contract is for a one-year
  term with two optional one-year renewal periods. LADWP agrees to a
  minimum expenditure of 25 percent and a maximum expenditure of
  125 percent of the estimated amount. The cumulative maximum expenditure
  shall not exceed $364,781,001.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

  25. Recommended by Power System
  Approval of Amendment No. 1 to Contract No. 797 for Construction Services
  for Underground Conduits and Substructures with Doty Bros. Construction
  Co. The Amendment extends the Contract term from December 9, 2026, to
  February 9, 2027, and the current not to exceed amount of $104,620,722
  remains unchanged.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

  26. Recommended by Water System
  Approval of Sale of City of Los Angeles Property to the Bridgeport Indian
  Colony. The sale of the Property will result in revenue of $300,000.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15060(c)(3).

  City Council approval by ordinance is required.
